# Checklist: api

<!-- Branch: feature/007-onboarding-de-orgs | Date: 2026-09-27 -->

The feature adds no REST route, but it changes two shared contracts (`ByIDArgs`, the anonymous
identity read) and introduces an HTTP status a client must be able to tell apart from another.

| ID | Check | Dimension | Ref | Status |
|----|-------|-----------|-----|--------|
| CHK029 | Does a **507** thrown at the hook T005 selects actually reach the client **as 507**? The two existing refusals (413, 415) are thrown in `beforeOperation`. A refusal moved to `beforeValidate` or `beforeChange` on a multipart upload may be wrapped as 400 or 500 on the way out. T010 asserts the status from a **real HTTP request**, not from the thrown error object | [contract] | FR-025, SC-013, T008, T010 | [ ] |
| CHK030 | Can `select?: Record<string, boolean>` express the projection CHK023 needs? **No.** `theme.primaryColor` is a nested group path, and a boolean map cannot name it. T015 would freeze the wrong type on `ByIDArgs` — and `FindArgs.select` (006) has the same limitation. Widen to a nested select type, or accept `theme: true` and state the reason. Decide **before** T015 | [contract] | FR-017, D8, T015 | ✗ found |
| CHK031 | Does renaming `PublicOrganizationTheme` to `PublicOrganizationIdentity` move every importer at once? Grep for importers first. An exported type rename is a breaking contract inside the repo, and a missed importer only breaks the build that lacks `payload-types.ts` | [versioning] | FR-017, T017 | [ ] |
| CHK032 | Is the refusal text in **PT-BR**, like the existing 413 and 415 messages, and free of internal identifiers — no tenant id, no organization id? | [errors] | FR-023, FR-034, T008 | [ ] |
| CHK033 | Is `storageQuotaMb` bounded below? It declares **no `min`** today (`collections/Organizations.ts`). A negative quota refuses every upload with a nonsensical *"restam"* figure. T002 adds `min: 0` | [validation] | FR-021, FR-033b, T002 | ✗ found |
